intent: Materialize the DECIDED best-way + rationale for each topic of the church study -> course-materials pipeline as in-app documentation, under a 'Church Local Infrastructure' project, using the discussions (institutional-memory / Events-as-data) model so each entry RENDERS in the app (Projects -> the project -> Discussions driving this; and the Discussions tab). Repo research-review doc = the survey (docs/99-session-notes/2026-06-23-research-review-body-study-to-course-materials-pipeline.md); these entries = the decided best-way.
poe_binding: Decisions-with-rationale (we chose X not Y because Z). Word-first, served-not-surveilled, three-brakes, app-is-primary. Church-NAS holdings are 'pending inventory' until read-only access exists - no fabricated facts about NAS contents.
apply: Idempotent. Apply once in Supabase Studio against the COLG cloud instance: run infra/seed-data/2026-06-23-colg-local-infrastructure-docs.sql (resolves the instance by slug='colg'; ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING). Renders live after apply. NOT yet applied to cloud as of this commit.

projects.title: Church Local Infrastructure
projects.description_md: COLG sovereign local-infrastructure build: church NAS (~100 TB) + CUDA box + local AI, and the study/recordings -> structured course-materials pipeline that runs on it. Umbrella for the decided best-way + rationale on source, retention, processing topology, access, faithful extraction, consent, curation, trivia, and the end-to-end pipeline. Survey: docs/99-session-notes/2026-06-23-research-review-body-study-to-course-materials-pipeline.md.

projects.title: Content Engine
projects.description_md: The unified content engine: ONE shared transcript->structure engine, multiple sources (church recordings + Darrell's in-app conversations) -> multiple outputs compiled in sequence (lessons -> curriculum -> books -> digital-marketing assets). Broader than the church-infra build; holds the engine framing, conversations->lessons, curriculum->books, and the firm phased timeline (CPU-now vs GPU-later). Survey: docs/99-session-notes/2026-06-23-research-review-body-study-to-course-materials-pipeline.md sections 12-15.

discussions.title: Source = BOTH church-NAS originals + YouTube archive, reconciled
discussions.body:
BEST WAY: treat the church NAS originals AND the YouTube @thelovecorner archive (UC821pJh7YR5llBNnWUJj-ZA, 836 videos since Sep 2014) as ONE reconciled set. Their union = the comprehensive video history; the matched pair (date/title/duration/hash) cross-verifies completeness AND fidelity. Built on the existing in-app choir_sermons catalog (migration 0013) for the on-YouTube side.

WE CHOSE both-reconciled, NOT church-NAS-only and NOT YouTube-only, BECAUSE two independent copies of the Word let us prove nothing is missing or truncated and let us sanity-check each transcript against the published version - a misquote is far less likely to pass unnoticed. Church-NAS holdings are PENDING INVENTORY until read-only access exists; the 836 figure is verified.

discussions.title: Retention = keep the single BEST version (~100 TB church NAS)
discussions.body:
BEST WAY: verify with both copies, then RETAIN only the single best version per item - criteria in order: (1) audio quality (dominates transcription accuracy), (2) completeness/uncut, (3) resolution/bitrate. Record matched-pair provenance (date/title/duration/hash/which-source-won) even though only one file is kept, so verification history survives without duplicate storage. Capacity: ~100 TB total after 5x12 TB add (RAID caveat: 60 TB raw -> ~48 TB usable at SHR/RAID-5, ~36 TB at RAID-6; total pool still ample). Whole archive best-versions ~1-2.5 TB - vast headroom.

WE CHOSE best-of-one, NOT redundant duplicates, BECAUSE storage is not the constraint - cleanliness is; two copies are for VERIFICATION, one copy is for RETENTION.

discussions.title: Processing = the app is the cockpit, running ON the CUDA boxes
discussions.body:
BEST WAY: the PoeTech PWA opens locally ON the GPU machine (church + home). That app instance IS the processing + orchestration node - it reaches the LOCAL GPU (faster-whisper + Ollama on CUDA) and the LOCAL recordings (church NAS on the same LAN) directly. Operating the pipeline = clicks in the app that become local API calls (Reconcile / Build / Monitor / Review / Publish). The sovereign sync layer keeps both sites coherent. Local-conductor / GPU-does-the-work.

WE CHOSE app-on-CUDA-as-node, NOT external scripts and NOT cloud processing, BECAUSE the app is the primary artifact (AI-FOUNDATION-INTERNAL-OPERATIONS: a click today is an API call tomorrow), low-latency local LAN + local GPU is fully sovereign, and nothing leaves the box. The app is the control plane; raw GPU work stays native (don't force-fit the app where it adds no value).

discussions.title: Access path = tailnet (primary) + owner-export Takeout (fallback)
discussions.body:
BEST WAY: the acquisition gap is an ACCESS problem, not a download problem - originals already sit on the church NAS. PRIMARY: reach them over the LAN (app-on-CUDA at the church) and cross-site over Tailscale (home + church on one tailnet from the COLG NAS build). Reaching/authenticating to the church NAS is a credential / his-hand step (Darrell/BG hold the creds; the pipeline does not) - needs tailnet membership for the processing node + a read-only service account/share. FALLBACK, only for items on YouTube but missing from the NAS: the OWNER exports via YouTube Studio download / Google Takeout (it's COLG's own channel) and lands them on the NAS.

WE CHOSE tailnet-access + owner-export, NOT yt-dlp/scraping and NOT pulling through our tools, BECAUSE it is rights-clean and sovereign - a channel-owner credential action, never a scrape, never our tools holding their creds.

discussions.title: Faithful-extraction guarantee = bias input + verify output + matched-pair cross-check
discussions.body:
BEST WAY: a misquoted verse attributed to a speaker NEVER ships unverified. Three layers: (C) contextual biasing - feed Whisper a scripture-aware initial_prompt (66 book names, Bishop Gwin, Church of the Living God, KJV register) to cut errors at the source (arXiv:2410.18363); (D) post-hoc verification - detect every reference with a Bible-verse parser (pythonbible / python-scriptures) and check each quote against LOCAL canonical KJV/ESV, flag drift; (E) matched-pair cross-check - sanity-check the transcript against the other copy (NAS original vs YouTube mirror) + the choir_sermons title/speaker. Flagged verses go to human review; ESV primary / KJV secondary; fetch the actual translation, never reconstruct from the model.

WE CHOSE bias+verify+cross-check, NOT fine-tuning Whisper, BECAUSE there is no labeled COLG corpus yet and fine-tuning overfits on scarce data; verification is proven-to-catch and runs today (Verification Doctrine / DR-0076). Fine-tuning parked for the GPU era.

discussions.title: Privacy/consent = consent-at-source + Presidio scrub + human backstop
discussions.body:
BEST WAY: congregant names, prayer requests, and testimonies are scrubbed or consented before anything becomes shareable (served-not-surveilled). Layered: (C) consent-at-source - default posture PRIVATE unless it is the teaching of the Word, which is shareable; media team can tag teaching vs personal segments; (B) Microsoft Presidio auto-scrub - local NER+regex strips names/PII before storing transcripts, custom recognizers for prayer/testimony, image-redaction for on-screen lower-thirds; (A) human backstop - the review queue shows consent flags beside faithfulness flags; nothing publishes until cleared. Teaching recordings ONLY - building Surveillance-Station camera feeds are out of scope.

WE CHOSE consent-as-governance + automated first-pass + human backstop, NOT automation-only, BECAUSE NER catches names but not intent - the human is the final gate (DATA-AS-EMPOWERMENT, COMMUNITY-FIRST, QUALITY-OF-LIFE).

discussions.title: Curation = newest-first, by series, behind the three brakes
discussions.body:
BEST WAY: process newest-first, one series at a time, manual-run, with all three brakes (budget ceiling + single-instance concurrency lock + kill-switch). Backfill of the 836-item history is OPT-IN and batched, never auto-fired. Honest 'N of M', never a silent cap. Matches the sme-pipeline's existing manual-run posture.

WE CHOSE newest-first manual-run, NOT batch-everything, BECAUSE auto-backfilling 836 items is the exact runaway the three-brakes rule forbids (2026-06-06 incident) and the human REVIEW queue is the real bottleneck regardless of GPU speed. CUDA buys speed, NOT permission to remove brakes (FEEDBACK_AUTONOMOUS_AUTOMATION_THREE_BRAKES).

discussions.title: BG Wednesday-1PM trivia Q&A = questions BG poses -> in-app answers
discussions.body:
BEST WAY: the questions Bishop Gwin poses at the end of a message become the lesson's check-for-understanding - answered in-app, graded app-side, RLS-scoped to the church instance. Reuses the shipped Engagement surface + trivia_answers table + engagement-sync (uploadTriviaAnswer/sendMessage/subscribeMessages). The Body's own questions feed the trivia, not just generated quiz items. Currently a static John 18 anchor set; the weekly auto-generation is blocked on Gmail OAuth (BG's emailed Wednesday message via Christina's inbox).

WE CHOSE reuse-the-Engagement-lane + the Body's real questions, NOT a new trivia surface and NOT only machine-generated questions, BECAUSE the lane is built and waiting on the same OAuth, and the Body's contributions are first-class source (the directive's heart). The text wedge (BG message -> lesson + trivia) is the cheapest first increment.

discussions.title: End-to-end: recordings -> course materials (the whole pipeline)
discussions.body:
BEST WAY (the umbrella): reconcile-both -> retain-best -> app-on-CUDA transcribes (scripture-aware) -> faithfulness gate -> consent scrub -> structure into a MODULES lesson (objectives/segments/anchor refs/the Body's contributions/trivia) -> human review (Governor-gated) -> publish newest-first into Learn + Presenter + Study + Engagement + Church clips. Operated entirely through in-app surfaces. Reuses sme-pipeline, learn-framework, the Presenter contract, the trivia lane, Study, choir_sermons, and the discussions model. New links only: church-NAS access, the reconciliation/retention engine, the faithfulness gate, and the in-app cockpit.

WE CHOSE app-operated, gate-first, human-in-the-loop, NOT scrape-and-auto-publish, BECAUSE the Word must be verifiably faithful (two copies, canonical check), people must be consented (served-not-surveilled), and the human governs the bright line - the system advises with receipts, Darrell/BG decide. Tier B/C: soaks before it ships. Survey: docs/99-session-notes/2026-06-23-research-review-body-study-to-course-materials-pipeline.md.

discussions.title: Unified content engine: sources -> lessons -> curriculum -> books -> marketing
discussions.body:
BEST WAY: ONE shared transcript->structure engine, source-agnostic. SOURCES: church recordings (NAS union YouTube) + Darrell's in-app conversations (discussions / Study / chat-in / family-voice / private thinking space, owner-family-scoped). OUTPUTS compiled in sequence: LESSON (Learn/Presenter) -> CURRICULUM (course/series, learn-framework shape) -> BOOK (downloadable PDF/EPUB, owned content only) -> MARKETING ASSET (lead magnet/product). Each arrow is a compile step behind the same three brakes + the same Governor review gate; the same app-on-CUDA cockpit operates every stage.

WE CHOSE one engine many sources/outputs, NOT separate one-off tools, BECAUSE the transcript->faithfulness-gate->consent->MODULES->review->publish spine is identical whether the input is a recording or a conversation - reuse, not rebuild.

discussions.title: Conversations -> Lessons (in-app conversation sources, CPU-now)
discussions.body:
BEST WAY: point the same engine at in-app conversation data (Supabase discussions, Study reflections/thinking-space, chat-in conversationLog, family-voice, the yahweh-discussions append). No transcription for text sources -> CPU-OK today, no GPU dependency. PRIVACY IS THE SENIOR GATE, INVERTED: recordings default teaching=shareable, but conversations default PRIVATE (especially the Study thinking space - process-don't-store is binding). The engine is OPT-IN PER ITEM - Darrell picks a conversation to turn into a lesson; nothing auto-publishes his private processing. Presidio scrub + no-leak visibility filter still run. Faithful structuring unchanged (model organizes, never improvises; faithfulness gate verifies any verse he quoted). Phase 1 MVP (pick-a-conversation -> draft lesson -> review -> publish to Learn) ~3-5 build days, depends on privacy scoping. Phase 2 batch-all-history behind brakes, GPU-accelerated only where voiced clips need transcription.

WE CHOSE opt-in private-by-default, NOT auto-ingest-all-conversations, BECAUSE the Study space is his most private thinking - he selects what becomes public, the system never decides that for him.

discussions.title: Curriculum -> Books (PDF/EPUB; NOT the financial Books tab; owned content only)
discussions.body:
BEST WAY: compile a course/curriculum into a downloadable book (PDF/EPUB), positioned as a digital-marketing asset (lead magnet/product). PREMISE CONFLICT SURFACED: the app's existing 'Books' tab is the FINANCIAL LEDGER (accounting - BooksEntities.jsx, Books->Tx/Imported), NOT a publishing/library shelf - there is no existing downloadable-book surface. Do NOT bolt a book library onto the accounting tab. RECOMMEND: home the library in the Learn/Church area where curriculum lives, reusing the CreationWorkspace export primitive (creation-workspace.js); matches the tracked 'Worldview teaching book - finish + publish' goal. EXPORT: Option A print-CSS -> PDF (zero-dep, recommended MVP); B jsPDF/pdf-lib; C +JSZip EPUB. HARD RULES: (1) NO payment/monetization build - book + download + marketing packaging ONLY; payment is Darrell's hand. (2) COPYRIGHT - owned curriculum (church content, Darrell's conversations) is fine; do NOT embed copyrighted song lyrics or third-party text; derived data only (scripture refs, themes, paraphrase-marked). (3) A book inherits its lessons' verified status - nothing with an open faithfulness/consent flag compiles. MVP ~3-5 build days (print-CSS); EPUB +~2.

WE CHOSE Learn/Library-home + zero-dep export + owned-content-only + no-payment-build, NOT the financial Books tab and NOT scraping copyrighted text, BECAUSE 'Books' means two different things in the app and we ship only what we own and can verify.

discussions.title: Firm phased timeline (CPU-now vs GPU-later)
discussions.body:
BEST WAY (phases gated by dependencies, not calendar): P0 text wedge BG-message->lesson+trivia (~2-3d, CPU, dep Gmail OAuth). P1 Conversations->Lessons MVP (~3-5d, CPU, dep privacy scoping). P2 Recordings->Lessons MVP (~4-6d, CPU-slow/GPU-accelerates, dep faithfulness gate + one recording). P3 Lessons->Curriculum (~2-3d, CPU). P3c Sermon Stories MVP (~3-5d, CPU, dep transcripts + The Word-Migdal sub-tab). P4 Curriculum->Books MVP (~3-5d, CPU, dep Library-surface decision + export). P5 Reconciliation+retention engine (~5-8d, CPU, dep church-NAS access via tailnet). P6 In-app cockpit on CUDA (~6-10d, homes on GPU box, dep GPU online). P7 Batch backfill 836 videos + all-history incl. story extraction (GPU-LATER, dep GPU + P5 + P6 + brakes). P8 Books->Marketing packaging (~2-4d, CPU; payment = his hand, NOT built). The ENTIRE sources->lessons->curriculum->books->marketing spine is demonstrable end-to-end ON CPU with owned conversation data before any GPU dependency; only P7 batch genuinely requires GPU. SEQUENCING: P0/P1 -> P3 -> P4 (prove the whole compile chain to a downloadable book on owned content) -> then P2/P5/P6/P7 as church-NAS access + GPU box land -> P8 when products are wanted.

WE CHOSE prove-on-CPU-first, NOT wait-for-GPU, BECAUSE the cheapest highest-value path (owned conversations -> lessons -> curriculum -> book) needs no new hardware; GPU is only the batch-backfill accelerant.

discussions.title: BUILD #1 (prioritized MVP): Sermon Stories — BG's reusable illustration library
discussions.body:
PRIORITY: this is BUILD #1 - the prioritized first deliverable of the whole content engine (Darrell 2026-06-24), ahead of conversations->lessons and books, because it is the most build-ready high-value slice (needs only ONE transcript from one manual sme-pipeline run - no church-NAS access, no GPU, no reconciliation engine - and lands in BG's existing study surface). Build-ready detail (table sermon_stories, extraction prompt, first-PR checklist) is in research-review section 16. BEST WAY (requested by Bishop Gwin himself): a THIRD engine output alongside lessons + books - extract every story/illustration BG tells and collect them into HIS personal section as a reusable searchable library, so he doesn't dig through old sermons to find an illustration for a new one. LANDS IN: The Word - Migdal (the existing staff-gated Bishop's-study surface - Pulpit.jsx, pulpit-prep.js, reads choir_sermons) as a NEW 'Sermon Stories' sub-tab via theWordTabs - extend, NOT a new top-level surface (ties to prior BG-study lane local_cb09eb75). RECORD per story: the anecdote (his words, faithful, not fabricated), the point/moral, the scripture/theme (faithfulness-gate verified), source sermon + date + timestamp (jump-back), speaker via speakerKey; searchable/filterable by theme/scripture/topic. TWO PARTS: (1) reuse-from-old - auto-extract discrete stories he ACTUALLY told from the sermon corpus (same NAS-union-YouTube transcripts as lessons/books); (2) new-story sourcing aid (optional) - curated, attributed, theologically-aligned stories for NEW sermons; BG curates, not auto-insert; copyright: attribution + summary/reference only, never reproduce copyrighted text. ACCESS SCOPE (trusted-steward set, NOT BG-only and NOT public): OWNER = Bishop Gwin (full read/write/curate, he makes the grants); SHARED read/use = Darrell (system steward) + Christina. Modeled on the unified roles/membership layer (instance_members role + role_scopes + user_in_instance helpers) as a NAMED SUBGROUP narrower than user_in_instance - the same shape the Choir module uses (user_in_choir): a defined subset gets read/use, owner edits. Enforce with a role_scopes grant / user_in_sermon_stories_stewards predicate, NOT the broad instance-member check. Design-level scope only - the actual grants are made by the owner (BG) through the app roles UI, not a live flip. PRIVACY (senior gate) still applies WITHIN the set: stories may name congregants/family - DEFAULT PRIVATE; Presidio scrub + no-leak visibleDiscussions filter; consent/scrub before any sharing beyond the trusted three. FAITHFUL ONLY: model extracts candidates, BG VERIFIES before a story is kept; unverified stays candidate, never auto-canonical. Reuses the transcript pass + faithfulness gate + speakerKey + corpusPrep search + Presidio + discussions visibility; new code only = the story-extraction prompt + the sub-tab. Timeline: P3c ~3-5 build days CPU (rides P2 transcripts); batch back-catalog rides P7 (GPU).

WE CHOSE extend-The-Word-Migdal + BG-private-by-default + faithful-with-BG-verify, NOT a new surface and NOT auto-canonical extraction, BECAUSE it is his personal section and his stories - the system surfaces candidates, the preacher verifies and decides what to keep or share.

discussions.title: Community engagement on sermons + lessons (reactions / ratings / most-loved / radio stations)
discussions.body:
BEST WAY: apply the SAME community-engagement pattern as the Worship/Music section to BG's sermons + the engine's lessons/courses (+ everything else that makes sense): reactions (love/emoji, CLEAN Word-first CHILD-SAFE reaction set), community ratings, most-loved ranking, and a radio/continuous-play STATION (e.g. a 'Most-Loved Sermons' station, ratings-driven ordering of the sermon library). RIDE THE SHARED ENGAGEMENT PRIMITIVE being designed in the consolidation lane local_ad147f53 - ONE primitive, MANY surfaces (music + sermons + lessons/courses); REUSE, DO NOT FORK (align with feedback-sync rating vocab love/good/rough/broken + engagement-sync, don't duplicate). ATTACHES TO SHAREABLE SURFACES ONLY: The Word-Migdal public sermon library (choir_sermons / theword_public_sermons) + ChurchLearn lessons/courses. BOUNDARY: BG's PRIVATE Sermon Stories do NOT get community reactions (not community-visible); if BG shares a story into a public lesson, engagement rides that public lesson, not the private record. SCOPE: community-scoped per PIN-optional-community-default; CREDIT BG (speakerKey attribution on every sermon/most-loved entry); most-loved orders DISCOVERY, never ranks truth by popularity; engagement data is the community's own, sovereign, never sold (DATA-AS-EMPOWERMENT). TIMELINE: rides the shared primitive's delivery (local_ad147f53), additive once each surface ships; does NOT change BG Sermon Stories = Build #1.

WE CHOSE reuse-the-shared-primitive across surfaces, NOT a separate sermon-reactions stack, BECAUSE one engagement primitive serving music + sermons + lessons keeps it clean/consistent/child-safe and avoids forking; most-loved is a find-it-faster signal, not a doctrine signal.

discussions.title: Single source for the whole engine: historical archive + continuous future
discussions.body:
BEST WAY (engine-wide, Darrell 2026-06-24: 'it's all already captured in the historical videos on YouTube and Church NAS, and into the future'): ONE source for EVERYTHING the engine produces - BG's sermons/stories, choir songs, SME/keyboardist instruction, worship self-critique, lessons, curriculum/books, music, and the engagement surfaces. The source = the HISTORICAL archive (church NAS union YouTube @thelovecorner, reconciled both-ways, best-version retained) PLUS ongoing/FUTURE recordings (continuous auto-feed). NO NEW DEDICATED CAPTURE STEP - the engine processes the existing + continuous archive; capture already happened and keeps happening. SELF-CRITIQUE / worship-review (SME pipeline lane local_eceef6e5) pulls a learner's PAST altar presentations FROM THE ARCHIVE (review work already done) and every future service auto-feeds new material. ALL outputs reference this shared source via the one reconciliation/retention spine - never a bespoke source per surface. CONTINUOUS INGESTION = a BRAKED queue, not an unbraked loop: new recordings land -> processed -> auto-route to the right surfaces behind the three brakes (budget + lock + kill-switch); ties continuous-feedback-reel cadence + church-NAS-as-source + app-on-CUDA. 'Continuous' = newest-first + auto-routed, NOT always-on-unattended - per the 2026-06-06 runaway lesson the auto-feed ships INACTIVE (Tier C), turned on only with someone watching; the human review gate still clears every shareable output before publish. Does NOT change BG Sermon Stories = Build #1.

WE CHOSE one-archive-feeds-all (historical + continuous), NOT a separate capture per output, BECAUSE it is all already captured and the future auto-feeds - the engine's job is process-and-route, not re-record.

discussions.title: Engine properties: depth-adaptive (book-capable, quick/standard/deep) + interest-personalized
discussions.body:
BEST WAY (engine-wide property of EVERY output - lessons, scripture material, courses, books; Darrell 2026-06-24): (A) DEPTH-ADAPTIVE + BOOK-CAPABLE - author each piece deep enough to be a BOOK, then scale DOWN to lighter tiers (QUICK = essence/point/anchor verse; STANDARD = the working lesson, default; DEEP = the full book-grade treatment) so each consumer takes it at the depth they currently need. It is the reading-depth analog of the time-adaptive Presenter's proportional reflow - CORE MEANING PRESERVED AT EVERY TIER, only elaboration scales; authored once at book-depth, lighter tiers are reflows not different content. REUSE the proven primitives: learn-framework resolveLevel/LEARN_LEVELS/chunkLessonForAge + Study deep<->plain distillState; generalize to quick/standard/deep across lessons->curriculum->books (a book renders at the reader's chosen tier). Faithfulness holds at every tier - a verified scripture quote is carried verbatim into quick/standard, reflow never paraphrases the Word silently. (B) INTEREST-PERSONALIZED - surface topics + depth matching what the consumer engages with. SIGNALS (priority): (1) in-app engagement (primary, sovereign) - their own reactions/ratings/most-loved/opens (sec 17); (2) the consumer's OWN YouTube viewing history (optional enrichment) - viewing history as interest signal ONLY via their own consented import (their data/Takeout), NEVER by surveilling their account. HARD RULES: opt-in/off-by-default (engine works fully un-personalized); served-not-surveilled (no tracking, no engagement-maximization, no dark patterns); owner-scoped + sovereign + exportable + deletable + NEVER sold/shared (advertisers/employers/insurers never) (DATA-AS-EMPOWERMENT); personalization orders DISCOVERY, never gates the Word - anyone reaches any tier/topic regardless of profile. Applies across the whole chain (sources->lessons->curriculum->books); single source (sec 18) feeds it, gates clear it, these properties shape HOW each consumer receives it.

WE CHOSE author-deep-then-reflow-down + opt-in-sovereign-personalization, NOT lowest-common-denominator content and NOT surveillance-based recommendation, BECAUSE every piece can be a book AND meet a seeker at a glance, and we meet each person where their interest is without ever surveilling or selling them.

discussions.title: Engine property: experience + cognitive-level adaptation (understanding for ALL / UDL)
discussions.body:
BEST WAY (engine-wide, Darrell 2026-06-24 - the same book/content taught at every experience AND cognitive level, understanding for ALL): ON TOP OF the depth tiers (sec 19; depth = how much elaboration), this adapts to the LEARNER on two orthogonal axes - EXPERIENCE (seeker -> new believer -> mature -> scholar; reuse learn-framework LEARN_LEVELS/resolveLevel) AND COGNITIVE/AGE (young child -> youth -> teen -> adult; reuse AGE_BANDS/resolveForAge/chunkLessonForAge). A 10-year-old, a new believer, and a scholar each receive the SAME truth at the level they can understand - CORE MEANING PRESERVED across all levels, faithful, never dumbed-down-wrong (a simpler version is true+complete for its level, never a distortion). UDL MECHANICS: multiple representations text/AUDIO/visual (reuse the see/hear pair lib/tts.js read-aloud + lib/text-size.js large-print + diagram media) - read it/hear it/see it; reading-level scaling (plain-language <-> scholarly, ties depth + Study distillState); ACCESSIBILITY (binding) - dyslexia support (planned Literacy Justice module: OpenDyslexic/Lexend, color overlays, line tracking, structured literacy) + text-size + TTS + voice-to-text, no learner shut out by ability. Faithfulness at every level - verified scripture carried VERBATIM into every rendering; representation + reading level change, the Word does not.

WE CHOSE same-truth-every-level (experience x cognitive, UDL), NOT separate content per audience and NOT one-size-fits-all, BECAUSE understanding-for-all means the child, the new convert, the elder, the scholar, and the learner with dyslexia all receive the same Word at the level they can hold - none excluded by age, experience, or ability.

discussions.title: Engine property: testing for retention (hold the Word) - encouraging + faithful
discussions.body:
BEST WAY (engine-wide, Darrell 2026-06-24 - content tested so learners HOLD the Word of Yahweh): comprehension checks + retention assessment on every lesson/course/book. MECHANICS (reuse + extend): comprehension quizzes (reuse learn-framework gradeQuiz/QUIZ_PASS_RATIO/courseAssessment, shipped); active-RECALL questions from the lesson's points + anchor verses (the BG Wednesday trivia lane is one live source); SPACED REPETITION (new) - resurface key truths + verses over time so they stick (light SRS over missed/weak items); MASTERY checks per lesson/book feeding courseAssessment -> graduate->helper. TONE/WELLBEING (BINDING): encouraging + mastery-oriented, NEVER punitive or shaming (kids + all ages) - celebrate growth, allow retries, no harsh scoring; a miss is 'let's revisit' not a shaming grade (QUALITY-OF-LIFE system-as-mirror-never-judge; matches the repo's non-punitive disposition vocab). ACCURACY (BINDING): what's tested is Yahweh's WORD - references + answers faithful/verified, NEVER a misquote; any scripture in a question/answer is checked through the faithfulness gate (canonical text fetched, never reconstructed) - a test that misquotes the Word is worse than no test; the gate fails the question before it is asked.

WE CHOSE encouraging + faithful retention testing, NOT punitive scoring and NOT unverified questions, BECAUSE testing is FOR THE LEARNER (that they hold the Word) - celebrate growth, retry-friendly, accurate to the Word, never shaming and never a misquote.
